title: Lower bound on a uniform probability
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set and let $g:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. If the uniform average of $g^2$ is positive and the uniform average of $g^4$ is at most $81$ times the square of the uniform average of $g^2$, then the uniform probability of the set of $x\in\Omega$ for which the uniform average of $g^2$ is at most $4g(x)^2$ is at least $1/144$.
